snippet.title: ALIS - World Reborn | Learn. Survive. Connect.
snippet.description:
ALIS is an open-source Unreal Engine 5 survival game about learning, survival, and human connection in a post-apocalyptic real-world city.

Project: https://fall.is
Source: https://github.com/fallintodusk/alis

Music: “Per aspera ad astra” by Andrei Gordeev, licensed under CC BY 3.0.
https://soundcloud.com/mcpn07jppy1y/per-aspera-ad-astra
